title: Build a game loop
instruction: Put in order what a game does 60× a second, over and over!
steps: Move the characters and work out their new positions
Update the score and lives according to the rules
Draw the whole scene on the screen again
debrief: A game repeats the same loop dozens of times a second: input, movement, collisions, rules, drawing. That's why everything seems to run smoothly.
why: First the game has to know what the player pressed.
The new positions of the characters are worked out from the input.
Whether objects touched can only be told from the new positions.
The collisions tell you whether the score goes up or a life is lost.
Finally the scene is drawn with everything that changed in this round.
